text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: deploy window check failed for release 2026-03-22-canaryB in us-west-2. Canary health 4/8 passing. spike in 5xx and p95. pausing next traffic ramp. details: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/slo/serve-us-west-2 :triage:

anika: noticed a batcher OOM signature in the logs around 10:12. get trace id: trace=abcd1234, throwing 503s from encoder-worker.

sam: grabbing logs. encoder svc shows repeated "out of memory while allocating buffer" from vmem arena. new allocator introduced in rcB?

leo: rcB included smart-batch-agg and small-buffer optimization. maybe aggressive pre-alloc combined with bigger batch size.

anika: proposal: safe-hold + reduce canary weight to 0, pin to last-good 2026-03-10-stable. then apply quick config rollback on encoder: set max_batch_tokens=1024 -> 512 and allocator=legacy. anyone object?

sam: +1, we should also flip off smart-batch-agg flag. small patch: `services/encoder/prod.flags`: `smart_batch_agg=false, allocator=legacy, max_batch_tokens=512`

kai: runbook step: execute `/deploy hold --release 2026-03-22-canaryB --who anika` then `/routing set-weight --service encoder --version 2026-03-10-stable --weight 100`

anika: doing the hold now. `/deploy hold --release 2026-03-22-canaryB --reason "encoder OOMs"`

deploy-bot: ACTION: release paused. canary traffic ramp stopped. Notifying release owner and oncall.

devops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INF-20260322-enc-oom and added logs link: https://internal.logs/enc/abcd1234. assigned to eng-runtime.

sam: applying config flip to encoder cluster in us-west-2 via hotpatch. command: `hc hotpatch apply encoder-usw2 --patch-file patches/encoder-hotfix-20260322.json`

leo: hotpatch applied. starting synthetic ping test: loop 10x with small payloads to exercise path. results: 200 x10, median time 0.18s, no 5xx in last 60s.

anika: checking SLOs: p95 dropped back to baseline ~140ms, 5xx rate within error budget (0.2% in 15m). looks stable so far.

kai: recommend keep release paused until next deploy window to validate longer-run stability. rollback not necessary yet. schedule follow-up: full regression test + load test.

anika: agreed. I'll update release notes and mark status=PAUSED. sam please follow up in the ticket with heap profile and heapdump.
